title: Fabrication of flame retardant toughened PLA base 3D printed materials with modified lignin by phytic acid
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38294-38306
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06156C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Siqi Ren, Dongfang Fan, Qian Zhang, Yunhong Jiao, Jianzhong Xu, Jixing Xie
A flame-retardant and toughened PLA-based material suitable for 3D printing was prepared by modifying lignin with phytic acid and diethyltriamine and combining it with toughened PLA.
